product_description: Round cutting and grinding discs, manufactured from agglomerated synthetic abrasives, bonded with phenolic resin and reinforced with glass fibers. The abrasives consist primarily of aluminum oxide (corundum). The discs have a diameter ranging from 115 to 230 mm and a bore of 22.2 to 25.4 mm. The thickness of the discs varies from 1 to 6.3 mm. They are used for grinding and cutting various metals using electrically or non-electrically powered (hand) tools.

A synthetic preparation containing no petroleum or oil from bituminous minerals, offered in the form of an aqueous solution in packaging of 1 l, 5 l, or 25 l. The sprayable product is specially suitable for preventing the adhesion of welding spatter to metal workpieces, so that it does not need to be chipped off or ground away after welding. The preparation has a long-lasting anti-stick effect, is non-toxic, non-explosive, non-flammable, and non-carcinogenic. The preparation is also rust- and corrosion-resistant. It improves welded joints and weld seams.

According to the information provided, this is a four-wheeled electric wheelchair for people with limited mobility. The wheelchair has adjustable armrests (armrests), which can be easily folded out and made comfortable to sit on, and it also includes a cane holder. The wheelchair is equipped with a separate adjustable (folding) steering column, on which the control panel is located and the basket is also attached. It is equipped with a reverse gear and when the electric drive is turned off, the wheelchair can also be pushed in front of you. It can be folded to facilitate transport. Technical parameters: — engine power: 350 W; — battery: Lithium 36 V 12 Ah; — charger: 40 V 2 A; — load capacity: 120 kg; — dimensions: 99 x 55 x 85 cm; — tire size: front 9", rear 10"; — max. speed: 10 km/h; — range: 40 km; — brake: electromagnetic; — angle of climb: 15°; — display: LED.

According to the declared data, this is a treat for dogs; a chewy treat in the shape of small sticks (a white stick base made of beef hide wrapped in dried chicken meat). The product is intended for direct consumption by animals as a reward or treat (not intended for human consumption). Ingredients: chicken meat 65%, beef hide 30%, rice starch 5% (serves as a technological binder for fixing the meat layer to the rawhide base). The product contains less than 10% by weight of starch, but does not contain any dairy products. The finished products are packaged for retail sale, packed in plastic bags and then placed in cartons intended for distribution.

Applicant's specifications: Filling hose for AdBlue/urea (AUS32), 1 m - ideally suited for refilling urea additives; enables clean refilling, no contamination or unpleasant odors in the interior - suitable for 5-liter and 10-liter canisters. Findings on a sample: A hose was submitted consisting of a transparent, flexible inner hose made of plastic with a matching funnel-shaped adapter (with filter function) and a black, grooved outer hose made of plastic, fitted with plastic connectors on both ends. The inner hose has a diameter of approximately 0.8 cm and the outer hose has a diameter of approximately 2.0 cm. It is assumed that the hose cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa or more. Conclusion: This is a different type of plastic hose, neither reinforced with nor combined with other materials, with fittings, closures, or connectors.

The product described as a "chrome-plated frame base" is made of chrome-plated aluminum and measures 40 x 342 x 460 mm (W x H x D). It essentially consists of a long base rail with a rib projecting upwards from each end. The upper end of the base is attached to a vanity unit using screws and the included mounting hardware. The frame base is a necessary and identifiable component of vanity units of the type used in bathrooms, ensuring the unit's stability at the appropriate height. The product is to be classified as "an identifiable metal part of furniture other than those covered by headings 9401 and 9402." Attachment: an illustration

Refined copper foil. The goods are a foil of refined copper (99.9%) with a thickness of 0.012 mm to 0.14 mm, which is cut to approximately 580 mm x 650 mm or traded on rolls. The goods are used for electronic applications. The goods are to be classified under subheading 7410 1100 of the Combined Nomenclature as foils and thin strips of copper (whether or not printed or on paper, cardboard, plastic or similar substrates), with a thickness (excluding the substrate) of 0.15 mm or less, of refined copper.

The product described as "L Pen Ballpoint Pen" is a ballpoint pen with a non-replaceable refill and paste-like writing ink. The writing instrument is approximately 17.2 cm long and consists essentially of a two-tone (pink at the bottom, black at the top) plastic casing with a printed company logo on the side, a stylized pink plastic hand with outstretched thumb and forefinger attached to a spring, and a refill with a metal ball at the writing tip. The product is to be classified as a "ballpoint pen, not with liquid ink, with a non-replaceable refill." Attachment: an image

Applicant's information: Polymer mixture of various copolymers. A sample was not submitted. Confidential information on the composition of the granules was available. According to this information, alpha-methylstyrene predominates by weight among the monomers. Finding: Other plastic within the meaning of Note 3 to Chapter 39, not elsewhere specified or included, in primary form.

Applicant's description: GMP ("Good Manufacturing Practice") compliant, xeno- and serum-free culture medium for the maintenance and propagation of undifferentiated human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) under feeder-free conditions. The product is in the form of a liquid nutrient solution to support both automated and manual workflows. Description: Prepared nutrient substrates for the cultivation and maintenance of microorganisms (including viruses and the like) or plant, human, or animal cells.

Boron trifluoride enriched with boron-11 isotope. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is chemically homogeneous boron trifluoride with a purity of more than 99.99% by weight, enriched with the boron isotope 11B to a content of more than 99.9% at. The product is registered as a chemical under CAS number 20654-88-0. According to the information provided, it is used for semiconductor manufacturing. Based on its chemical composition, the product is to be classified under subheading 2845 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as isotopes (excluding isotopes of heading 2844); inorganic or organic compounds of these isotopes, even if not chemically homogeneous; other.

Connector, essentially consisting of a plastic housing with four internal metal contact pins on one side and the corresponding number of angled protruding contact pins for printed circuit board mounting on the opposite side, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, for establishing an electrical connection by inserting a corresponding mating part after mounting (soldering) on ​​a printed circuit board. The goods are to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of 1000 V or less, connector for printed circuit boards". Attachment: 1 Figure

The goods described as a "garden seating set" are a set presented for individual sale, consisting essentially of: - a wooden bench; 113 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), - two wooden chairs; 50 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), and - a wooden table; 110 x 52 x 45 cm (L x W x H). The seating is equipped with custom-fit, loose seat and back cushions and is available in cream and anthracite. A dining table is not included due to the low height. The nature of the set is determined by the number and intended use of the seating. The products are designed to be placed on the ground and are suitable for furnishing, for example, patios. The unassembled, packaged assortment of goods is to be classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, upholstered". Attachment: an illustration

So-called universal safety plug, consisting of a specifically shaped plastic housing with a removable plastic cap, a plug on one side and a cable connection on the opposite side, and an integrated, replaceable fuse, for a voltage of 12 V, for automotive cigarette lighters (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), for making an electrical connection after the assembly of a cable by inserting a corresponding mating contact (characteristic main activity of the combined machine) and for protecting electrical circuits or connected loads. The goods are to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of 1000 V or less, plug, other than for coaxial cables or for printed circuits, not for specific aircraft, other than those specified in TARIC subheadings 8536 6990 82 to 8536 6990 86". Annex: 1 Figure

A so-called mobile residual oil measuring device, presented as a retail package, essentially consisting of a measuring device whose characteristics are defined by its use, permanently installed in a specially manufactured plastic case, a power supply, a PTFE connecting hose (Ø 6 mm), an instruction manual, a calibration certificate, and a USB flash drive (all components are located in the case). The measuring device, which is operated with the case open, essentially consists of a stainless steel housing (282 x 168 x 139.7 mm) with a sample gas inlet, sample gas outlet, a touchscreen, status LEDs, a dosing chamber, a measuring chamber, a vacuum diaphragm pump, a pressure sensor, a PID sensor, a humidity sensor (for internal measurements), a power supply input, a Modbus RTU via an RS485 interface, an analog output, and other electrical, electronic, and optical components. It serves for the early detection of potential contamination in compressed air systems. For this purpose, a partial flow of compressed air is extracted from the system and directed to the PID sensor. Hydrocarbons are ionized by a special UV lamp, generating an ion current proportional to the concentration of ionized molecules. This current is amplified and converted into electronic and voltage signals. Measurement results (measuring range: 0.001 to 5.000 mg/m³) are displayed, stored internally, and can be output in both analog and digital formats. The product is classified as an "electronic gas analyzer."

The goods described as a "wall-mounted boot rack" are a piece of wooden furniture measuring 73 x 50 x 15 cm (L x H x D). They consist essentially of two L-shaped wooden profiles with holes or fixings for wall mounting, and between them two parallel wooden slats, each with ten 15 cm long, rounded rungs running diagonally upwards. The goods are intended for storing items such as boots (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision) in kindergartens or schools. The goods are classified as "furniture made of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." Attachment: an illustration

Sheet of non-alloy steel. According to the information provided, the goods are a flat product of non-alloy steel (Q235). The sheet has a length of 3140 mm, a width of 150 mm, and a thickness of 6 mm. It was produced by hot rolling and cutting. The goods are used, according to the information provided, as cutting guides (burning table strips) in plasma and oxy-fuel cutting systems. Based on its material properties, the goods are classified under TARIC code 7211 1400 95 as flat rolled products of iron or non-alloy steel, with a width of less than 600 mm, neither clad nor coated, hot rolled only, other, with a thickness of 4.75 mm or more, with a width of 500 mm or less, other.

Applicant's description: So-called teat liner (rubber or soft rubber), consisting of a dimensionally accurate, specifically shaped, flexible rubber tube manufactured according to a drawing, with a total length of approximately 300–340 mm and an outer diameter of approximately 50–62 mm, as well as an integrated head for attachment and sealing in the teat cup and a milk hose section (straight or angled), for use as a teat liner after installation in the teat cup of a milking machine. No product sample was submitted. The product was illustrated by photographs and technical drawings. These show that it is a tapered product with an integrated attachment and sealing head. Finding: This is a different product made of soft rubber.

Applicant's information: This is a connector, fitting, or nozzle that is installed in a foot brake module. The connector consists of a housing, a guide sleeve, and a locking ring, all made of plastic; it also includes a soft rubber O-ring, a clamping ring, and a metal star washer. The connector is used to connect an air hose to the foot brake module. No sample was submitted. The plastic connector was illustrated by a technical drawing and product information. Finding: This is a connector (made of plastic) for pipes and hoses.

Feed charcoal for dogs and cats - charcoal produced from the carbonization of freshly harvested wood chips (according to the applicant) under anaerobic conditions, in granular form (particle size: < 3 mm), - packaged in 500 g or 2 kg bags, - for use as feed charcoal for dogs and cats. "Charcoal, not from bamboo, not from shells or nuts, not exported from Somalia"

The product described as a "3-in-1 Bamboo Toilet Brush Set" is a composite product, essentially consisting of a toilet brush and a piece of furniture (comprising a stand and a shelf). The product consists primarily of a base plate made of plastic-coated cement, from which a powder-coated steel pole extends upwards. At the top of the pole is a bamboo holder for smartphones, and below this is a small bamboo holder with an enlarged, rounded end for toilet paper. The set also includes a plastic container attached to the base plate, which serves to hold the toilet brush. The toilet brush has a plastic ferrule and bristles, as well as a bamboo handle. The furniture and the toilet brush constitute a composite product, the nature of which is determined by the furniture's importance for its intended use. The furniture is designed to be placed on the floor. It is a piece of furniture made of various materials (metal, wood, plastic, and cement), but no single material is identifiable as having a defining characteristic. The goods are therefore classified under the last-mentioned of the equally applicable subheadings. There is no indication of handwork. The goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402 and subheadings (HS) 9403 10 to 9403 83, not handcrafted". Attachment: an illustration

Application details (assumed to be correct): Fruit and vegetable juice mixture with fruit puree, ginger juice and wheat germ oil, presented for retail sale (500 ml bottle with screw cap). Alcohol: not included. Products or fats from products of headings 0401 to 0404: not included. Sucrose or invert sugar: included. Non-alcoholic beverage, other than those specified in UOS codes 2202 1000 to 2202 9915 of the CN, containing sugar (sucrose or invert sugar), other.

Strawberry fruit powder with maltodextrin. According to the application, the product is a fruit powder consisting of strawberry pulp and maltodextrin, obtained by spray drying. It is used in the production of ice cream. Glucose or starch (according to the application): more than 5% by weight; food preparation not elsewhere specified or included, not belonging to subheadings 2106 1020 to 2106 9059 of the Combined Nomenclature (CN), containing more than 5% by weight of glucose or starch; due to the predominant maltodextrin content, not a fruit preparation of heading 2008 of the CN.

The product is a component approximately 41 x 40 x 20 mm (L x W x D) manufactured according to a technical drawing from a copper-zinc casting alloy. The component has an internal thread and functions as a spindle nut for supporting and guiding a spindle. It is part of an operating table and is installed in the leg plates. The packaged product is classified as a "recognizable part of a piece of furniture for human medicine."

Applicant's information: Christmas tree ornament tins made of tinplate in three designs. They contain three chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Findings on samples: Three approximately cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate (dimensions: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5 cm) filled with a light beige, firm cream, in the style of pralines; odor: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream. The pralines are individually wrapped in red metal foil (label: "milk cream"). The pralines are in a metal tin, which does not constitute packaging within the meaning of General Rule 5(b) (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29438/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines in the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other

Description: Cardboard packaging in the form of multicolored printed rabbit heads in two different designs, containing two small chocolate eggs, a bite-sized chocolate bar, and a bag of gummy bears. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: A colorfully printed, hexagonal cardboard folding box (motif: rabbit head), closed at the top with a green textile ribbon. The cardboard folding box contains a cellophane bag filled with the following confectionery: - a brown chocolate bar filled with a beige cream. The bar is sealed in colorfully printed plastic film, printed with (excerpt): "choco & cream". - two hollow chocolate eggs, individually wrapped in colorfully printed metal foil. - A rectangular, colorfully printed, sealed plastic bag containing 14 gummy bears in different colors (red, green, yellow, and white), length: approx. 2.5 cm, width: approx. 1.4 cm. Findings: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of bars, sticks, or tablets: filled.

Details: Transparent sanitary silicone; 1-component silicone-based sealant; for use in corner, movement, and connection joints in sanitary and kitchen areas, for window and glass sealing, for sealing seams of display cases and glass blocks, and for small-area bonding (e.g., window muntins); Packaging: 310 ml cartridge with screw-on dispensing nozzle. Findings: Based on its composition and intended use, the product is classified as a different type of putty (plastic putty).

According to the application, the item is a star-shaped decorative object measuring approximately 30 cm long x 30 cm high x 5 cm deep. The product consists of a basic framework of wooden slats, which is wrapped with flexible grapevine branches (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a wickerwork technique. A textile hanging loop is attached to the top. The wickerwork, in terms of its extent and importance to the decorative effect, defines the character of this handmade product. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "Other goods, produced directly from plant-based wickerwork materials other than bamboo or rattan, other than straw bottle sleeves, handcrafted".

Recombinant antigens in solution. These products are biotechnologically (recombinantly) produced antigens (proteins) of human, microbial, or viral origin, expressed in suitable host cells and purified. The antigens are present in aqueous, frozen solutions. The antigens are usually traded in quantities of 1 mg, 5 mg, or 10 mg per package. The antigens are used for the manufacture of diagnostic immunological tests. The goods are to be classified as vaccine-like products under subheading 3002 4900 of the Combined Nomenclature. They are not immunological products within the meaning of Note 2 to Chapter 30 of the CN.

According to the application and the submitted product information, the product is a set of goods packaged for retail sale (cardboard box), consisting of: - a thermally insulated, specifically shaped drainage system (so-called gully) made of polyurethane, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, -- with a foamed-in connection sleeve of approximately 495 x 495 mm made of polyvinyl chloride, -- integrated into an insulating body of approximately 1000 x 500 x 120 mm (L x W x H) made of polyurethane or mineral wool (depending on the model), - a flexible vapor barrier panel made of plastic, - stainless steel pipes with a total length of 2 to 4 m, - stainless steel connectors, retaining clamps, and pipe clamps, - various assembly and fastening materials, - paper assembly instructions. The disassembled product serves as a component in the construction of flat roofs for the flow-through drainage of roof surfaces and is incorporated into a flat roof structure for this purpose. Particularly with regard to its quantity and significance in relation to its use, the plastic determines the nature of the goods. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as a "construction material made of plastics, not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (CN) 3925 1000 to 3925 9020".
Description: Mica; Mineral. Product characteristics: Light, fine, shiny powder (muscovite, mineral substance), packaged in a sample container. Findings: Mica powder.

Applicant's description: Goods consisting of a tape dispenser and two rolls of polypropylene tape with a maximum roll width of 19 mm, with a plastic-based adhesive. The tape dispenser consists of two interlocking plastic halves and a serrated tear-off edge made of base metal. The mini-dispenser, together with the two tape rolls, is packaged in a plastic bag in retail packaging. No sample was submitted. Classification: Sheets, plates, films, foils, tapes, strips and other flat products, self-adhesive, made of plastics, also in rolls; in rolls with a width of 20 cm or less; other; other; other

According to the application details and the accompanying illustration, the product is a rectangular woven material made from dried reed stems (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46), arranged parallel to one another and bound together in a mat-like form using binding material (thin metal wires). The product, measuring approximately 50 x 100 cm (height x length), is primarily intended for use as frost protection for plant containers and pots. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "wickerwork, joined parallel to one another in a sheet-like form, even if this gives it the character of finished goods (e.g., mats, straw mats, latticework), made from plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, and not from wickerwork or similar articles made from wickerwork."

These are specifically shaped hollow products made of a nickel-chromium alloy with a predominant nickel content by weight (Inconel 625 – according to the applicant). The approximately cylindrical products, manufactured by turning, have a stepped flange on the outside. They are used to produce glass-to-metal inlets for the insulated passage of electrical conductors through a hermetically sealed housing. Such products are classified as "other nickel products (than those specified in code 7508 1000 00 0)" under tariff heading 7508 9000 00 0.

Provitamins and vitamins, mixed together. The product is a mixture of the vitamins niacinamide, thiamine hydrochloride, and vitamin C on the carrier mannitol. It is in powder form and is used as a premix for the manufacture of confectionery (fruit gums). The product is to be classified as "provitamins and vitamins, mixed together" under subheading 2936 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

The product described in the application and illustrated is a sports ball in the shape of a beach volleyball, size 3, with a diameter of approximately 15 cm, corresponding to the size of typical children's sports balls, made of sewn-together neoprene pieces, with a special silicone print for high grip, inflatable, and printed with a company logo. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "equipment for other sports, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 95, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9506 1110 to 9506 6100, inflatable ball".

According to the applicant's statements and the submitted sample, the product is a decorative item in the shape of a stylized Christmas tree. The approximately 1-meter-high product consists of white, honeycomb-patterned paper pieces glued together, which, when unfolded, form the three-dimensional shape and are secured with small Velcro dots. To enhance the decorative effect, an LED string of lights with an electrical cord, timer function, and mains plug is hung inside the Christmas tree and attached with Velcro dots. Classification as a lighting fixture within the meaning of heading 9405 is not possible, as the string of lights merely enhances the decorative effect of the honeycomb structure. The character of the composite product is determined by its size and decorative effect, as well as by the honeycomb structure. Such products, manufactured in the style of classic "honeycomb garlands/honeycomb products," serve as decorative items for celebrations, decorating rooms and/or tables. Due to its neutral design, it is not a Christmas article of subheading (HS) 9505 10. The goods are packaged in a cardboard box. According to customs tariff regulations, they are classified as "festival items, other than Christmas items".

Product Details: Bell peppers filled with a mixture of raw, minced chicken (Gallus domesticus) and rice, frozen. The chicken is uncooked. This product is intended for cooking by the consumer (simmer in a pot for approximately 40-50 minutes) and is not suitable for raw consumption. Net weight: 800 g. Composition (weight percentages based on the total weight of the product): - Bell peppers: 55% - Raw, minced, boneless chicken: 24% - Rice: 10% - Onions, carrots, sunflower oil, salt, black pepper: 11% total. Product description based on a photograph: Several red bell peppers, cut open at the top and filled with a yellowish-brown mixture. The stuffed peppers are in a black plastic tray sealed with clear film. The package is wrapped with a colorful printed cardboard band containing information on the ingredients and preparation instructions. The product is deep-frozen and is to be prepared by boiling in a pot. No sample was submitted. The product was illustrated by photographs. Findings: Meat, offal, blood or insects, otherwise prepared or preserved: of poultry of heading 0105: of chickens: other: other

Preparation based on odorants; strawberry flavoring. The product in question is a colorless liquid with an intense strawberry odor. The sample is in a 100 ml plastic screw-top bottle with a printed label. The flavoring, which is reportedly natural, is used in small doses for the production of fruit gums. Confidential information, including details of the composition, is available. The product is to be classified as another preparation based on odorants, of a kind used in the food industry, under subheading 3302 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Details: A musical figure made of polyester with an electronic music module that can be played at the push of a button. It contains a chocolate bar and five chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: A brown chocolate bar (dimensions approx. 12 x 3 x 1 cm) made of solid milk chocolate with break lines, sealed in colorfully printed plastic film (print (excerpt): "choco snack Fine Milk Chocolate 35 g"). The chocolate bar, together with the chocolate pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-1), is in a plastic bag, which is tied with a red ribbon to a musical figure (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-2) with a cardboard label (diameter approx. 6.5 cm). Label (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This vZTA decision relates exclusively to the chocolate bar from the assortment with a musical figure and chocolate pralines. Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of tablets, bars or sticks: unfilled: other

Confectionery; Gummy candies. The goods in question are gummy candies sold as part of a set containing a plush toy and chocolates. The gummy candies are packaged in 50g plastic bags. This binding tariff information (BTI) decision relates exclusively to the pack of gummy candies included in the set with chocolate pralines (DEBTI-40868/26-1), a plush toy (DEBTI-40868/26-2), and two chocolate bars (DEBTI-40868/26-4). The goods are to be classified under subheading 1704 9065 of the Combined Nomenclature as non-cocoa confectionery, other, other, other, gummy candies and jelly products, including fruit pastes in the form of confectionery.

According to the applicant's information and the submitted sample, the so-called severed body parts are replicas of three human fingers, an eyeball, and an ear. The products, intended for spooky decoration, are made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 and are packaged in a polybag with a cardboard header. Classification as festive (Halloween) articles under heading 9505 is not possible due to the neutral design and lack of festive significance. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, statuettes and other ornamental articles."

Aldehyde; o-Phthalaldehyde. According to the submitted data sheet, the product is the chemically homogeneous compound o-phthalaldehyde with a purity of at least 99%. One abbreviation is OPA. The CAS number is 643-79-8. The product is a yellow, crystalline powder and is used in papermaking. It is to be classified as a miscellaneous aldehyde under subheading 2912 29 of the Combined Nomenclature.

The article illustrated by images and a data sheet is a floor/furniture glide for office chairs. The product, approximately 55 mm high, consists of a solid, nearly cylindrical polyurethane base (approx. 50 mm in diameter), a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, and a metal pin (approx. 11 cm in diameter) for attaching the base. Given its size and importance in relation to its use (floor protection), the plastic determines the nature of the product, which is composed of various materials. Five glides are packaged as a set and are classified under customs tariff regulations as "other plastic goods, furniture fittings, other than those specified in TARIC codes 3926 3000 40 to 3926 3000 50".

Description: Decorative plastic film for outdoor use, for laminating panels and profiles. Two-layer construction: PVC base film (thickest layer) coated with a pigmented polyurethane system. The plasticizer content is less than 6% by weight and the thickness is less than 1 mm. No sample was submitted. A photograph shows the product as a gray, rectangular film. Findings: Other films, not of cellular plastics, neither reinforced nor layered (laminated) or similarly bonded to other materials, without a backing, of vinyl chloride polymers, other, with a thickness of 1 mm or less.

The product illustrated by the sample, image, and description is an electric ceiling and wall light measuring approximately 1260 x 97 x 80 mm (L x W x H). It consists of a trough-shaped, solid-color plastic housing with four G13 sockets, two replaceable 120 cm LED light sources with T8 bases, a clear, ribbed plastic cover, and electrical components. These components include an optical proximity switch whose settings (brightness, sensitivity, and switching duration) can be preset using DIP switches. The light is rated IP65 for ceiling or wall mounting in indoor and outdoor areas. The light is packaged for sale in a clear plastic film and cardboard insert, along with instructions and mounting hardware. The product is to be classified as an "electric luminaire, not elsewhere specified or included, ceiling and wall luminaire, excluding those of a type used in public places or thoroughfares, intended exclusively for use with light-emitting diode light sources, made of plastic, not for civil aircraft".

The product is a DC motor in a plastic housing with three mounting points and a port for connecting an electrical wire. A shaft or gear extends from the housing. The product is a so-called actuator used to adjust flaps or air dampers in a vehicle's heating, ventilation and air conditioning system in order to regulate the direction of the air flow in the passenger compartment, switch between fresh air and recirculation and control the passenger compartment temperature. The actuator is controlled by the vehicle's climate control system. The product is a compact electromechanical unit consisting of a small electric motor with a gear system in a plastic housing. The product is not a synchronous motor. The electrical power consumption is between 5 and 15 watts and the motor is powered by direct current. Dimensions (H x L x W): 31.9 mm x 82.1 mm x 59.5 mm.

Children's coloring set, which includes a 39 × 120 cm black and white coloring poster and three double-sided crayons measuring 100 × 14 mm. The set is packaged in a rectangular gift box, inside which there is a separate box of crayons.

Food supplement for human consumption presented in hard capsules. Each capsule contains berberine (500 mg) and silymarin (100 mg), along with excipients. Free from milk fat or with a content of less than 1.5% by weight, sucrose or isoglucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight, starch or glucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight. Product packaged for retail sale in packs of 60 capsules. Function or use: Intended for food use.

Connector parts designed for high-voltage electrical substations (over 1,000 volts). They are manufactured from different materials (aluminum, steel, etc.) and come in various shapes, dimensions, and connector types (terminal-to-cable connector, straight terminal-to-cable connector, etc.) depending on the substation's specifications. Function or use: To complete or replace the part of the connector for which it is intended, always meeting the same standards as the original high-voltage substation connector being replaced and where it will be used.

A ring, with a profile that is neither completely circular nor flat, shaped and welded, manufactured according to specific dimensions for certain sizes of implantable heart valves (27 and 29) to be permanently incorporated into them. It is made from a cobalt-chromium-nickel-molybdenum alloy specially designed for integration into an implantable biological heart valve. Function or use: According to the applicant's declaration, its functions are: to provide structural rigidity to the polyester support of the valve; to stabilize the prosthesis stent; to provide anchor points for multiple assembly sutures; and to contribute to maintaining the geometry and mechanical performance of the device.
Overpressure valve (safety valve), designed to regulate the air pressure inside a robotic floor vacuum cleaner.

This lanyard is primarily made of synthetic fiber fabric (polyester) and consists of a flat, elastic webbing with an integrated energy absorber. The absorber is protected by a hinged pouch. The energy absorber loops are protected by a tubular webbing. The lanyard is equipped with two metal (aluminum) scaffolding carabiners and a self-locking metal (aluminum) hook. This safety device allows for fall protection during movement. It is packaged in cartons of 10 units for import. Length under tension: 1.50 m. Length at rest: approx. 1.20 m. Weight: 1.70 kg. Maximum user weight: 140 kg.

A mechanically manufactured garment accessory made of non-stretch knitted synthetic fibers (polyester), in the form of a black neck warmer. According to the manufacturer's specifications, the item contains neither rubber nor elastane. This neck warmer has a fleece lining made of synthetic fibers (polyester). The item is designed to protect the chin area from wind and is packaged in a carrying case.

A colorless and odorless compressed gaseous mixture composed of krypton and xenon, extracted from atmospheric air using air separation units (mainly oxygen, nitrogen, argon), an intermediate product used to obtain pure krypton and xenon after the removal of impurities and separation of the 2 main constituents for final use in the fields of lighting and electronic applications. It is packaged at a maximum pressure of 200 bars in containers designed for this purpose, mainly cylinders or cylinder assemblies (frames).

Food preparation based on cow's milk and vegetable fat, presented in paste form, containing less than 5% sucrose or isoglucose, less than 5% glucose or starch or flour, not containing milk fat, intended for human consumption, packaged for retail sale in 500g and 200g Tetrapaks.

This electrodiagnostic device, a 4-in-1 multi-scan health system, features four integrated sensors and is designed for home use. It functions as a non-contact thermometer, a single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG), a miniaturized pulse oximeter for measuring blood oxygen saturation, and a digital stethoscope for recording heart and respiratory sounds. Physicians can access these measurements in real time from anywhere, enabling them to provide accurate and personalized diagnoses. The device has an 8-month battery life and is rechargeable via a USB-C cable (included). It comes packaged in a box with a USB-C to 3.5mm jack adapter, a carrying pouch, and a user guide.
Food preparation based on pistachio, cashew nut and almond, presented in the form of an organic spread, packaged for retail sale in a glass jar weighing 200 grams.

A textile garment, designed for children 24 months and older, with a body height under 86 cm, in the style of a long-sleeved vest, made primarily of knitted fabric (velvet or sherpa depending on the model) and synthetic fibers (polyester), with a lining and bias binding in woven fabric (double gauze cotton). This item features a front opening with wooden buttons, and some models have front pockets. Dimensions: 34 x 35 cm. The item is available in 3 models and is individually packaged in a polybag for retail sale.
Food preparation based on wheat bulgur and Roquefort cheese, precooked, presented in the form of a cake to be heated for consumption, packaged for retail sale.

These are two decorative, freestanding Christmas tree ornaments in a shimmering gold and white finish, which cannot be sold separately. This item is sold exclusively during the Christmas holiday season. Dimensions: 21 x 10.5 cm; Material: - 90% Polypropylene; - 3% Iron; - 7% Wood.

Fruit preparation of the type mango and passion fruit jam, obtained by cooking with the addition of sugar, pasteurized, with a sugar content exceeding 30% by weight, packaged for retail sale in 284g jars.

Non-alcoholic water-based drink, high protein, high calorie chocolate hazelnut flavoured, intended for adults and children over 3 years old, malnourished or at risk of malnutrition, packaged for retail sale in 125ml bottles.

A spliced, sling-type rope designed for tree pruning, made of a hollow tubular braid of synthetic polyester filaments. The product is available in different colors depending on its diameter: green (12 mm), blue (14 mm), and black (16 mm).

Carrying bag with a round base, the exterior surface of which is primarily made of a plastic sheet visible to the naked eye (polyurethane on fabric), and which includes a grid and a label holder also made of plastic (polyurethane and PVC, respectively). It is designed to hold a helmet and has a handle on top.

A household textile item, in the form of a mitten-type glove, made of knitted synthetic fibers (polyester), according to the manufacturer's declarations. It is intended for use in removing pet hair from clothing, furniture, and all types of textiles. The two-tone item, with a hanging tag, is packaged for retail sale in a bag and then in a carton.
LED electric lighting fixtures with an aluminum alloy body. They are intended for industrial spaces, warehouses, showrooms, retail areas, and sports facility halls.

Pastry product, presented in the form of a frozen raspberry ingot, containing at least 5% by weight of sucrose, invert sugar or isoglucose, packaged for retail sale in cases of 16 pieces then in a master of 5 cases.

A dog leash, a type of animal harness, made from nylon, with a hook at one end and a loop sewn onto the other, designed to be attached to a harness when practicing sports with the dog. This item is available in various sizes and traction strengths.

A stationery item, similar to a notebook, containing 80 lined sheets in A6 format (100x170mm), presented in an assortment with a plastic ballpoint pen (acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene). The set is packaged in plastic packaging.

This item is a steel kitchen pantry shelf measuring 178.7 cm high, 121.4 cm wide, and 46 cm deep. These freestanding shelves can also be wall-mounted for added stability. The maximum load capacity is 750 kg.

A pair of clog-style shoes that do not cover the ankle or calf, with a plastic (EVA) outsole and a polyester textile upper. The shoe features a tightening buckle on the top to adjust to the wearer's foot shape. These shoes are fashionable and suitable for both indoor and outdoor wear. They are available in sizes 41 to 46.

A section of rigid aluminum rail forming the anchor point of a vertically anchored, guided fall arrest system. It is fixed to the supporting structure and serves as a guideway for the mobile fall arrest trolley. Construction: a single piece of aluminum alloy produced by extrusion, then cut to length and drilled with fixing holes. Smooth running surface. Length: 3.00 m.

Anchor support post designed to receive the curved aluminum upper extension of a rigid vertical lifeline, at the ladder's exit onto the access platform. Construction: - tubular shaft adjustable in height by manual interlocking and bolting, minimum height 1.10 m / maximum height 1.25 m - base plate with 4 holes, 10.5 mm in diameter - upper fixing plate, 10 mm thick - anchor eyelet mounted on a swivel, free rotation without a drive mechanism. Material: steel for all components. Surface treatment: cataphoresis coating, black passivation, polished finish. Net weight 10.45 kg, gross weight 12.80 kg.

Signal box equipped with its module, for railway signaling. The LEDs are white. Rated voltage required: 40 Volts DC, power 20W. The signal box is made of aluminum and is equipped with an M20 cable gland.

LED module designed for installation inside a closed signal box. Used for railway signaling, this LED module is intended to replace incandescent lamps in railway signaling systems. Requires a nominal voltage of 40 volts DC and a power rating of 20W.

A component of construction equipment (excavators, loaders, bulldozers, etc.), in the form of a non-cast steel hydraulic reservoir. Volume: 77L. The metal hydraulic reservoir primarily serves to: - Store the hydraulic oil necessary for the operation of the equipment's hydraulic circuits (excavators, loaders, bulldozers, etc.). - Dissipate the heat generated by the hydraulic system, acting as a heat exchanger. - Separate air and impurities from the oil through sedimentation and the presence of internal baffles. - Maintain stable pressure in the circuit, compensating for volume variations due to the movement of the cylinders and pumps. Manufacturing methods: - Cutting and forming: Laser or plasma cutting of the sheet metal, then bending or rolling to form the structure. - Assembly by welding: MIG/MAG or TIG welding to join the walls, bottom, and internal baffles. - Machining: Drilling of ports for hydraulic fittings, level indicators, filler caps, etc. - Quality control: Leak testing, pressure testing, and weld verification (radiography, ultrasound). Integrated equipment - Internal baffles: To limit oil movement and promote settling. - Filters: Air filter (filling), return filter, suction filter - Indicators: Oil level (visual or electronic), thermometer. - Fittings: Oil inlet/outlet, drain, air vent.

Various works made mainly of plastic (+80% PVC, 10% steel, 5% ABS), in the form of a hollow post, surface-worked and pierced at both ends, constituting part of the structure holding the pool cladding.

Instrument cluster for dashboards of commercial vehicles, buses, coaches and special equipment. Equipped with several CAN buses and a LIN port, the cluster displays at least the speed, energy level, RPM and engine temperature.
C-shaped copper connector. It allows for a connection between two cables to ensure electrical continuity to a measuring device. The maximum voltage does not exceed 1000 V.

Replacement parts kit for bicycle wheels, including a cassette body and its end cap (adapter/hub end cap). The body is a cylindrical piece machined from 100% aluminum, cast and molded, with external splines for the cassette sprockets. It features two ball bearings with an outer diameter not exceeding 30 mm. This spare part mounts directly onto the rear hub body to receive and drive the cassette.

Compact analog camera with a fixed lens, in the form of a module measuring 22 x 22 x 31 mm and a total weight of 14.20 g. The camera is equipped with an optical Sony 1/2.8" CMOS sensor with high light sensitivity (0.003 Lux), an F2.0 aperture lens with a horizontal viewing angle of 114° (121.5° diagonally) and image formats 4:3 and 16:9. A standard 6-pin Molex PicoBlade connector is used to connect to other components. It is powered by direct current in the range of 3.6 to 28 V DC and is designed to operate at extreme temperatures from -40 °C to +85 °C. The camera captures and transmits images in real time in a resolution of 1200 TVL and generates an analog video signal (CVBS) in the PAL or NTSC standard. The camera is primarily intended for installation on unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) in order to provided the pilot with a live video transmission (so-called FPV - First Person View). The device does not have its own memory, a slot for memory cards, nor does it have the option of internal storage or recording of video materials and images. The camera does not have the characteristics of the products listed in tariff subheadings 8525 81 to 8525 83. .

Gauze fabric made of synthetic fibers, secondary carpet backing textile, not combined with other materials (rubber, metal, other plastics), untreated, not painted, not impregnated, not coated, not covered, not layered, not laminated. The backing surface of finished carpets, on which the top layer of the carpet is sewn. Product composition: made of polypropylene, in widths ranging from 3 to 5.35 m.

Windshield washer concentrate made from partially denatured spirit. Colorless, transparent, alcohol-scented, easily moving liquid. The product is used as a raw material for winter windshield washer fluids, antifreeze fluids, and chemical products that can be used to clean other surfaces. Packaging: bulk: tanker, 1000L IBC tank, 200L drum.

Taper bush adapter. According to the information provided, the EN-JL-250 (UNI EN 1561) cast iron item is obtained by casting and subsequent turning, drilling, threading, and grinding. The product is intended for the mechanical coupling between shafts and components with a cylindrical bore, with or without a keyway, using tapered bushes. The adapter allows for fastening and transmission of motion, avoiding further machining of the components to be assembled. It is a coupling element for mechanical transmission systems.

Steel "capillary" for insertion inside a pressure sensor. The item is shaped like a small steel tube with a tiny hole. A filler material (mercury, oil, or NAK) is inserted into the hole to transfer pressure data from a hot spot to a cold spot (where the sensing element is located). The goods, as per the manufacturer's declaration, are intended exclusively for use as an essential component of pressure sensors.

The element identified with the code S42100912010 is an extruded aluminum body, intended to be part of an OMET mechanical system. It is a small structural profile, 48x38x26 mm, designed to ensure rigidity and geometric precision in mechanical motion or assembly applications. Aluminum, chosen for its lightness, corrosion resistance, and ease of machining, allows for a stable and long-lasting component. The piece is machined to tight tolerances, ensuring interchangeability and compatibility with other system elements. The machining instructions specify the absence of burrs, dents, or sharp edges, to ensure safety and surface quality. No anodizing treatment is required. The component, despite its small size, represents a functional element of a more complex assembly, such as a support, housing, or structural connection part.

Plastic container for cosmetic packaging. The product is composed of an acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) lid, an ABS base, an internal glass mirror, and a steel connecting pin that allows the lid to close. The container closes by applying pressure between the lid and base. The bottom has a recess into which the cosmetic product pod is inserted.

Devices designed to project images received via connection to source devices onto an external screen. The light source is laser; the projection system used is DLP (Digital Light Processing). Models come in various sizes. Native resolution: WUXGA (1920 × 1200 pixels). Brightness: up to 6,000 ANSI lumens. Maximum projection size: up to 300 inches on an external screen. Contrast ratio: 3,000,000:1. Video and audio connections: models feature the following input/output ports, in a variable combination depending on the version: two or three HDMI inputs, one or two USB ports, an RS-232C input, and an RJ45 (LAN) connector. Connection can also be made wirelessly via Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, as well as via the AirPlay 2 (mirroring from iOS/macOS devices) and Miracast/WiDi (screen sharing from compatible Android/Windows devices) protocols.

PLYWOOD STAVE MADE OF BIRCH WOOD. BY PARTICIPANT'S DECLARATION, THE ITEM IS SLIGHTLY CURVED OR FLAT FOR ITS ENTIRE LENGTH. IT MAY HAVE THE FOLLOWING DIMENSIONS: LENGTH FROM 35 CM TO 220 CM, WIDTH FROM 2.5 CM TO 20.5 CM, THICKNESS FROM 0.8 CM TO 4 CM; THE STAVE HAS ROUNDED EDGES ALONG ITS ENTIRE LENGTH AND IS MADE UP OF A MULTIPLE OVERLAP OF THIN WOOD SHEETS GLUED TOGETHER. THE FIBERS OF THE SINGLE LAYERS RUN PARALLEL TO EACH OTHER IN A LONGITUDINAL DIRECTION AND ARE PLACED IN ALTERNATE DIRECTIONS IN ORDER TO ALLOW AND MAINTAIN THE CURVE OR PRESENT A FLAT LINE.

PLYWOOD STAVE MADE OF BEECH WOOD. BY PARTICIPANT'S DECLARATION, THE ITEM IS SLIGHTLY CURVED OR FLAT FOR ITS ENTIRE LENGTH. IT MAY HAVE THE FOLLOWING DIMENSIONS: LENGTH FROM 35 CM TO 220 CM, WIDTH FROM 2.5 CM TO 20.5 CM, THICKNESS FROM 0.8 CM TO 4 CM; THE STAVE HAS ROUNDED EDGES ALONG ITS ENTIRE LENGTH AND IS MADE UP OF A MULTIPLE OVERLAP OF THIN WOOD SHEETS GLUED TOGETHER. THE FIBERS OF THE SINGLE LAYERS RUN PARALLEL TO EACH OTHER IN A LONGITUDINAL DIRECTION AND ARE PLACED IN ALTERNATE DIRECTIONS IN ORDER TO ALLOW AND MAINTAIN THE CURVE OR PRESENT A FLAT LINE.

These are insulated electrical cables with two to four conductors, partially enclosed by a common protective sheath. One end of the cable is fitted with a 2 to 4-pin connector, while the conductors at the other end are stripped for connection to a sensor and are designed for crimping or soldering. The cables are intended for voltages below 12V and are used in the automotive industry as electrical connections between a sensor and the vehicle electronics.

A non-stainless steel rod with a full-length metric thread, a tensile strength greater than 800 MPa, a hardness class of 8.8, 1 m long, and a diameter ranging from 6 to 20 mm. Manufactured according to DIN 976, this product is electro-galvanized. The rod is not self-tapping; once installed, it can be used with other components, such as nuts and washers. This product is used to reinforce, stabilize, and permanently connect various structural elements. Rods are packaged in cartons of 5, 10, 50, or 100.

These creamy yellow chickpea wafers are round, with a maximum thickness of 11.45 mm and a maximum diameter of 90 mm. They are made by expanding micropellets obtained through extrusion. The product contains, among other ingredients, chickpea flour, rice flour, potato starch, and salt. Each wafer is packaged in a polypropylene foil box, containing 17 wafers, with a net weight of 135 g.

Imitation firearms in the shape of various pistols. They have metal or plastic (ABS) and metal housings. This is an electric airsoft gun equipped with a gas compression device. When the trigger is pulled, the gas is released from the cylinder into the barrel, firing 6 mm diameter BBs. Maximum ejection force is from 0.5 J to 2.0 J. Firing range: from 20 m to 60 m. Product dimensions: length from 300 mm to 900 mm, inner barrel length from 50 mm to 300 mm, weight from 2500 g to 4500 g. The product is available with two barrel versions: threaded or non-threaded, and is packaged in individual cardboard and foam packaging with a magazine and a starter pack of BBs or just a pack of 50 BBs. Additional accessories may be included. According to the applicant's declaration, the products are used during sports competitions in dynamic and precision shooting as well as in tactical games.

The product is a heatsink made of cast aluminum alloy (AlSi12Cu1 Fe), designed with a special geometry to be mounted inside the handle/housing of an electromechanical tool. The part is dedicated exclusively to the electronic motherboard (tool control module). It comes into direct contact with the power electronic components on the motherboard, taking over the heat generated by them during operation through conduction and dissipating it into the air flow inside the handle. Its role is to prevent overheating and destruction of electronic circuits. The part has cutouts, profiles and fixing points on the motherboard that will be mounted in the internal cavity of the device handle.

The product is a heat sink assembly for a server processor, compatible with HPE ProLiant DL3X0 Gen11, 1U format, used for CPU heat dissipation in standard configurations. It is compatible with processors with TDP up to 185 W. Dimensions: 22.2 × 25.2 × 6.5 cm Weight: 0.43 kg

Contact rail made of copper-zinc alloy (brass), according to the information intended for installation in safety switches/load switches intended for 16 A. The switch is intended for voltages up to 500 V AC and is rated for 16 A AC-23A. It can also be used for motor loads up to 7.5 kW at 400 V. The contact rail is stamped and bent, approximately 51 mm long and provided with 2 holes with M4x0.7 – 6H. The contact rail's task is to conduct electrical current between the various contact parts of the switch. The rail is mounted with screws and comes into direct contact with these parts to maintain the electrical connection.

A screen-free coding toy designed to introduce children to early coding skills through hands-on play. The motorised fox follows black-line paths, allowing children to complete story-based coding challenges using coding tiles and an activity book. The set includes Scrambles the Fox, 16 coding puzzle tiles, a coding activity book, and a multilingual quick-start guide. The tiles measure approximately 7.5 cm × 7.5 cm, while Scrambles measures approximately 7.5 cm (L) × 5 cm (H) × 5 cm (W). The product is made of plastic and is supplied in retail cardboard packaging.
